st.title: Accessibility statement
st.metaDesc: How TradingAIHub supports accessibility: the compliance level (IS 5568 / WCAG 2.1 AA), adjustments made, the accessibility menu, known limitations and how to reach our accessibility coordinator.
st.intro: {site} is committed to making its website usable by everyone, including people with disabilities. We see accessibility as part of providing an equal, dignified and independent service, and we keep improving it as the site grows.
st.level: The site is designed to comply with Israeli Standard IS 5568, which is based on the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, at level AA, in accordance with the Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 5773-2013. To the best of our knowledge, the site's own pages meet this level, except for the limitations listed below.
st.adjustedH: Accessibility adjustments made on the site
adjusted: A “Skip to main content” link is the first item on every page, so keyboard and screen-reader users can bypass the header.
Everything can be operated with a keyboard alone, and a clearly visible focus outline shows where you are, in both the light and dark themes.
Text and interface colours meet the AA contrast ratio in both themes, and links inside text are underlined rather than marked by colour alone.
Every image has a text alternative; decorative icons are hidden from screen readers.
Every form field has a properly linked label.
Each page declares its language and text direction (right-to-left for Hebrew and Arabic). The site is available in 13 languages.
Each page has a single main heading, a logical heading structure and standard landmark regions (header, navigation, main content, footer).
The layout adapts to small screens and to zoom of up to 200% without loss of content or sideways scrolling. Text sizes use relative units, so your browser's text-size settings work.
The site respects the operating system's “reduce motion” setting, and animations can be stopped from the accessibility menu.
A built-in accessibility menu (described below) lets you adjust the display to your needs.
st.widgetIntro: Select the accessibility button (wheelchair icon) in the bottom corner of any page, or reach it with the Tab key. The menu offers:
widgetItems: Text size: make the text larger or smaller in steps.
High contrast: stronger colours for text, borders and buttons.
Highlight links: underlines and highlights every link.
Readable font: a plain sans-serif font with wider letter and word spacing.
Stop animations: stops animations, transitions and the counting effect on numbers.
Reset: returns all settings to their defaults.
A link to this accessibility statement.
st.widgetNote: We built the menu ourselves; it does not use any third-party accessibility service. Your choices are saved only in your own browser (localStorage), and you can close the menu with the Esc key.
st.limitsIntro: Despite our efforts, some content may not yet be fully accessible:
limits: Third-party websites we link to (for example TradingView, GitHub, and the websites and documentation of the listed tools) are not under our control, and their accessibility is the responsibility of their operators.

Information imported automatically from GitHub, package registries and vendor pages (such as tool names, descriptions, licences and pricing details) is shown as published by its source, often in English only.
Translations into languages other than English are partly automated and may contain inaccuracies.
Code samples and installation snippets are shown in English and left to right, because they have to be typed exactly.
Status badge images are generated automatically; their meaning is also given as text on each tool page.
st.limitsOutro: If you find content that is not accessible, please tell us (see below).
st.browsers: The site is designed to work with the current versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on desktop and mobile (iOS and Android), with keyboard-only navigation, and with common screen readers such as NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver and TalkBack. Older browsers may not display every feature correctly.
st.testing: Accessibility was checked with automated tools (axe-core) and by manual keyboard testing of representative pages, in English and Hebrew, in the light and dark themes, at mobile and desktop screen sizes.
st.physical: {site} is an online-only service and has no physical premises or service points open to the public.
st.contactIntro: If you run into an accessibility problem, need information in an accessible format, or have a suggestion for improvement, please contact our accessibility coordinator:
st.ask: To help us respond, please include the page address, a short description of the problem, and the browser and assistive technology you use (if any).
st.response: We will acknowledge your request within 5 business days and will work to fix the problem, or to provide the information in an accessible alternative, as soon as possible.
